form: gzipped BARE git repository, shallow-rooted at f3921a4d, no remotes, no promisor
why_not_a_bundle: git 2.43 bundle format v2/v3 does not carry the shallow boundary. A bundle produced from a shallow clone verifies as prerequisite-free but fails to clone: 'Failed to traverse parents of commit f3921a4d... remote did not send all necessary objects'. Reproduced and recorded. A full-history bundle would be self-contained but the repository carries ~544 MiB of tracked binary caches, so a shallow bare repository is the smallest artefact that gives a genuine offline checkout with unaltered commit hashes.
repair: remote.origin.partialclonefilter unset, then git fetch --refetch; the remote is readable (git ls-remote succeeds), only push is refused by the proxy

offline_readback.method: extract the tarball, git clone the bare repo with GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 and no network, check out the exact commit
